description: Any two nonempty countable dense linear orders without endpoints are order-isomorphic.
signature:
Order.iso_of_countable_dense.{u_1, u_2} (α : Type u_1) (β : Type u_2) [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] [Countable α]
  [DenselyOrdered α] [NoMinOrder α] [NoMaxOrder α] [Nonempty α] [Countable β] [DenselyOrdered β] [NoMinOrder β]
  [NoMaxOrder β] [Nonempty β] : Nonempty (α ≃o β)
